title: How much do you know about gender identity?
description: Test your knowledge of gender identity with this quiz.

questions.text: What is the difference between biological sex and gender?
options: Sex is biological, gender concerns personal and social identity
Sex is a choice, gender is not
questions.explanation: Biological sex refers to physical characteristics (chromosomes, hormones, anatomy), while gender concerns personal identity and social role.

options: A combination of biological and psychosocial factors
questions.explanation: Research shows that gender identity emerges from the interaction of biological factors (neurological, genetic, hormonal) and psychosocial ones.

options: Not identifying as either a man or a woman, or identifying with both
questions.explanation: Non-binary describes people who do not identify exclusively within the man/woman binary. It includes a range of gender experiences.

questions.text: Which organization removed transsexuality from the list of mental illnesses?
questions.explanation: The WHO (World Health Organization), in the ICD-11 (2019), reclassified the condition as 'gender incongruence', removing it from the chapter on mental disorders.

options: The distress that can result from the incongruence between gender identity and sex assigned at birth
questions.explanation: Gender dysphoria is the clinically significant distress that some trans people may experience. Not all trans people experience dysphoria.

questions.text: In twin studies, both twins are more likely to be trans if they are:
questions.explanation: Monozygotic twins show significantly higher concordance for transgender identity, indicating a strong genetic and biological component.

questions.text: What happens to hemoglobin levels during hormone therapy for trans women?
options: They drop to typical female levels
questions.explanation: Estrogens reduce red blood cell production. The hemoglobin levels of trans women on therapy approach those typical of cisgender women.

questions.text: Which of these aspects is NOT changed by hormone therapy?
questions.explanation: Chromosomes (e.g. XX, XY) are not changed by hormone therapy. However, most other biological aspects change significantly.

questions.text: Gender variance throughout human history is:
options: An exclusively Western and recent phenomenon
Documented in numerous cultures and in every historical era
Something that appeared only after the 20th century
questions.explanation: Gender variance has been documented across cultures on every continent: the hijra in India, two-spirit people in Native American cultures, the fa'afafine in Samoa, among many others.

questions.text: In the ICD-11, the WHO reclassified gender incongruence:
options: As a condition related to sexual health, not a mental disorder
It is not present in the ICD-11
questions.explanation: The ICD-11 (2022) moved gender incongruence from the chapter on mental disorders to the one on conditions related to sexual health, recognizing that it is not a mental pathology.
